sloka: जनकस्यात्मजा साध्वी स्नुषा दशरथस्य च ।स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः ।। ५.५८.८५ ।।।।
transliteration: janakasyātmajā sādhvī snuṣā daśarathasya ca ।svapno hyadya mayā dṛṣṭo dāruṇo romaharṣaṇaḥ ।। 5.58.85 ।।।।

translations.english: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.
